title: The Orbit of New Lagos
author: Theo Nystrom
blurb: Wren Thornbury, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
